description: Top Solana copy-trade leaders ranked by shrunk replay EV. Each wallet's last 60 big pump.fun buys are replayed through one fixed copy exit (stop, take-profit, trail and time stop, fees in, capped at +100%), then shrunk toward the pooled mean so short records do not top the board. Includes sample size, win share and the leader's own sell pattern. On-chain addresses only, no names. Rebuilt hourly; refused (503, not charged) if older than 3 h. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402).
name: sol_wallet_leaders
